guess.text: You record the video at 4 PM. It takes ten minutes, and you feel good about it.

By 11 PM you are still at it. Or you gave up, and posted nothing.
You know you have to create more videos. Everyone says so. You are not short of ideas. You are short of evenings.
So you watch other creators post every day and wonder how. Some of them pay an editor. The rest stopped doing it by hand.

setups.truth_title: Here is the truth nobody tells you:

truth.text: It is not that you are slow. It is not that you lack discipline.
Editing by hand is a full-time editor's job, and you are doing it after your actual day.
You do not need to get faster at it. You need most of it taken off your plate.

costs.head: The video that never got posted.
costs.text: Recorded, never edited, still in your gallery. A post that could have reached someone, gone.

costs.head: Your evenings.
costs.text: Hours on cuts and captions are hours you did not rest, earn or spend with anyone.

costs.head: Your consistency.
costs.text: Three posts one week, nothing the next. Your followers notice before you do.

costs.head: An editor you cannot afford.
costs.text: Paying someone per video adds up fast, so you do it yourself, and the cycle repeats.

fixes.then: The cuts are made for you.

Six ready-made looks, each previewed on your own clip before you choose. Or match a reel you love

math.text: Say editing one video takes you 2 hours. At ₦5,000 an hour, that is ₦10,000 of your time per video.
